item.title: Ch2.1 Establishment and Solution
item.description:
After the introduction in Chapter 1, we have completed the installation and configuration of the Python Development Environment. Now, we will officially start introducing the first algorithm: Linear Regression.

Following the learning method introduced in the preface, the learning roadmap for the entire linear regression is shown in Figure 2-1. Since this is the first algorithm introduced, we will introduce a lot of basic content, making it seem like there is a large amount of content. Therefore, the learning of the entire linear regression will be introduced through the content of 7 subsections. However, it is gratifying that as long as the learning of the first 4 steps is completed, the requirements of Stage 1 are basically met. Now, let’s officially start introducing linear regression.
